pages.title: Ritual Brazier
pages.text: A ritual vessel used in $(l:hexalia:core_mechanics/celestial_infusion)Celestial Infusion$(/l) and $(l:hexalia:core_mechanics/natures_ritual)Nature's Ritual$(/l). It holds ingredients, salt, and focused ritual energy.

pages.title: Crafting
pages.text: A Ritual Brazier is shaped directly in the world. Crouch and right-click any plank block with an $(l:hexalia:content/tools#athame)Athame$(/l) to carve it into a brazier.

pages.title: Use
pages.text: Place items into the brazier for rituals, then follow the requirements of the ritual being performed. Some rituals need salt, surrounding plants, or open sky before they can be activated.
